tiny-models.title: Tiny models
tiny-models.text: Built for small businesses without a GPU or a budget for expensive models.

a-plan-not-a.title: A plan, not a prompt
a-plan-not-a.text: GOAP builds a chain of actions towards the goal, so a small model stays on track.

uses-your-site-s.title: Uses your site’s tools
uses-your-site-s.text: Find a product, add to cart, compare — through the MCP / WebMCP tools you already have.

self-hosted.title: Self-hosted
self-hosted.text: The whole stack runs on one Linux machine with Docker Compose. Your data stays yours.

light-widget.title: Light widget
light-widget.text: One web component, under 40 kB brotli, works in React, Vue, Svelte or plain HTML.

see-every-decision.title: See every decision
see-every-decision.text: The admin panel draws each request as a graph: prompt, steps, tool answers, result.
